plugins.name: Audiobooks
plugins.tagline: Nyx's local audiobook library, narrator, and voice studio
plugins.description: Build a local audiobook library from uploaded audio or your own EPUB/PDF/text — narrated by real Kokoro text-to-speech with chapter-accurate playback, resume position, collections, and a voice-blending studio to mix custom narrator voices. Adds The Forge → Audiobooks to your sidebar.
plugins.author: SageTech
features: Real Kokoro TTS generation from EPUB, PDF, or typed text
Chapter-accurate playback with resume position, saved per book
Voice-mixing studio — blend built-in Kokoro voices and save as a reusable voice
Dedicated Voices browser with preview playback for every built-in and blended voice

plugins.name: Music
plugins.tagline: NYX's own local music manager & player
plugins.description: Upload and organize a local music library, build queues and playlists, save SoundCloud links for one-click replay, auto-import from watch folders, and control everything by voice. Adds The Forge → Music to your sidebar.
plugins.author: SageTech
features: Local library with drag & drop upload (MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, OGG)
SoundCloud links — save once, replay forever
Voice & chat control ("play after dark", "pause the music")

plugins.name: Agents
plugins.description: A live control center for Nyx's real specialized workers — Momus (fact-checking), Hemera (trend tracking), Analyst (reasoning), and OpenClaw (desktop automation) — with real status, provider configuration, API key management, and automatic fallback. Adds The Forge → Agents to your sidebar.
plugins.author: SageTech
features: Real agent registry — no fabricated agents or example data
Per-agent provider priority with automatic health-based fallback
Secure API key management (masked, backend-only, never logged)
Live status: active, processing, unavailable, missing configuration
